appshot_editor.title: Edit appshot
appshot_editor.gone: This appshot is no longer kept. Take a new one to edit it.
appshot_editor.load_failed: The picture could not be loaded.
appshot_editor.applied: The edited picture replaces the appshot.
appshot_editor.apply_failed: The edit could not be used: {0}
appshot_editor.hint_move: Click an annotation to select it. Drag to move it, arrow keys nudge it, Delete removes it. Double-click text to change it.
appshot_editor.hint_counter: Each click adds the next number.
appshot_editor.hint_spotlight: Drag over what matters; everything else dims.
appshot_editor.discard_body: Nothing has been copied, saved or used yet.
appshot_editor.done_hint: Use this version: your next message to {name} carries the edited picture
appshot_editor.drag_hint: Hold and drag the picture into any app
appshot_editor.drag_release: Keep the handle pressed while you drag.
